query:
with inserted as (
    insert into image (file_path, checksum, mime_type, updated, soft_delete)
    values ($1, $2, $3, $4, false)
    on conflict (file_path) do update
    set
    checksum = excluded.checksum,
    mime_type = excluded.mime_type,
    updated = $4,
    soft_delete = false
    returning id
)

select id from inserted

union all

select id
from image
where file_path = $1
